description: This file defines an abstract Java class 'AbstractPersistentActorWithTimersAndCleanup' extending 'AbstractPersistentActorWithTimers' from Akka, providing functionality for handling cleanup commands by deleting snapshots and persisted messages up to a certain sequence number. It is part of the 'org.eclipse.ditto' project and contains logic specific to persistence cleanup management in an Akka actor framework.

classes.name: AbstractPersistentActorWithTimersAndCleanup
classes.description: An abstract class extending 'AbstractPersistentActorWithTimers' that adds cleanup handling for persistent snapshots and messages up to a specific sequence number, including cleanup initiation, response handling, and cleanup completion checks.

methods.name: getLatestSnapshotSequenceNumber
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the latest snapshot sequence number for cleanup purposes.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Override to create a message handling receive block, processing cleanup commands and responses.

methods.name: staleEventsKeptAfterCleanup
methods.description: Returns the number of stale events to keep after a cleanup; defaults to 0.

methods.name: handleCleanupCommand
methods.description: Handles the CleanupPersistence command, initiating cleanup if needed.

methods.name: handleDeleteSnapshotsResponse
methods.description: Processes responses from delete snapshot operations.

methods.name: handleDeleteMessagesResponse
methods.description: Processes responses from delete message operations.

methods.name: checkCleanupCompleted
methods.description: Checks whether cleanup operations are completed and processes success or failure accordingly.

methods.name: isCleanupCompletedSuccessfully
methods.description: Determines if cleanup succeeded based on responses.

methods.name: getResponseStatus
methods.description: Provides a string description of the response status for logging.

methods.name: startCleanup
methods.description: Initiates cleanup by deleting snapshots and messages up to calculated sequence numbers.
